items.title: FDA clears AI tool that creates 3D bone visualizations from standard MRIs
items.excerpt: MRI2CT won FDA clearance for AI that turns standard MRIs into CT-like 3D bone models, aiming for 'MRI-only workflows in spine care' that spare patients the extra radiation of a CT.

history_match.title: FDA clears AI tool for pediatric bone age assessments

items.title: Physicians fire back against HHS secretary's claim AI is 'better informed' than human docs
items.excerpt: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said AI is 'better informed' than human doctors and could 'free us from medical tyranny'; physician groups pushed back on patient-safety grounds.

items.title: Radiology AI authorizations rise 42% as regulatory landscape evolves
items.excerpt: A new analysis of the FDA's AI-enabled medical device database details how radiology AI authorizations jumped 42% and how the regulatory pathways behind them have shifted.

items.title: Suki launches 'Ask' feature for clinical decision support driven by Wolters Kluwer UpToDate AI API
items.excerpt: Ambient-documentation vendor Suki launched 'Ask', letting clinicians pose complex clinical questions inside its assistant and get answers grounded in Wolters Kluwer's UpToDate evidence via a new AI API.

items.title: Early epilepsy detection from electronic health records with large language models
items.excerpt: LLMs applied to EHR notes separate epilepsy from psychogenic non-epileptic seizures earlier; the two look alike but need very different management, and misdiagnosis is common.

history_match.title: Evaluating large language model responses to unsafe clinical instructions

items.title: An audit-ready EHR foundation model for order-time medication-safety auditing across health systems
items.excerpt: ClinicalGPT, an EHR foundation model, audits medication orders for safety at order time across health systems, flagging when stale or missing lab and medication evidence undermines the check.

items.title: An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications (MedGemma)
items.excerpt: MedGemma, Google's open medical vision-language models built on Gemma 3, shows advanced understanding and reasoning across medical images and text in multiple imaging domains, published in Nature Medicine.

items.title: FDA spells out 2027 AI guidance plans
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: the FDA lists the new AI guidance documents it expects to issue in 2027, shaping how AI-enabled medical devices and software will be regulated.

items.title: HHS announces new efforts to speed up, expand clinical trials with AI
items.excerpt: HHS and ARPA-H unveiled efforts to use AI to speed up and expand clinical trials, pitched as a way to compete with countries like China on clinical research.

items.title: Anthropic joins ARPA-H clinical AI moonshot, will hold closed-door health care event
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: Anthropic has joined ARPA-H's clinical AI moonshot and plans a closed-door health care event; also MAHA's health-data goals.

items.title: Riverain's ClearRead Chest AI comes to RapidAI platform
items.excerpt: ClearRead Chest, which helps radiologists detect pulmonary nodules, pneumothoraces and coronary artery calcification on chest CT and x-ray, now runs on RapidAI's Rapid Edge Cloud and Navigator Pro workflow.

items.title: CARPL.ai, HOPPR partner on AI foundation models
items.excerpt: CARPL.ai is making HOPPR's medical imaging foundation models available on its radiology AI deployment platform.

items.title: n1.care launches AI clinical intelligence platform
items.excerpt: n1.care is rolling out an AI platform that merges imaging, lab results, genetics and records from multiple providers into one longitudinal view; licensed clinicians review each report before patients see it.

items.title: “AI가 내린 우울증 진단 믿지 마세요”…政, 과의존 경고
items.excerpt: 보건복지부와 대한신경정신의학회가 정신건강의 날을 앞두고 생성형 AI의 우울증 진단을 의학적 판단으로 받아들이지 말고 위기 상황에선 전문가 도움을 받으라고 당부했다.

items.title: 심평원 AI 심사 강화에…'사전점검 솔루션' 주목
items.excerpt: 심평원이 9월부터 무릎관절 분야 AI 의료영상 판독 결과를 실제 진료비 심사에 쓰기 시작하는 등 심사를 AI 중심으로 재편하자, 병원들의 청구 사전점검 솔루션도 고도화되고 있다.

items.title: 동국대일산병원, AI 활용 '개인에서 조직으로'… AX 전환 시동
items.excerpt: 동국대일산병원이 AI 챌린지 시상식과 AI TFT 위원회 출범으로 개별 직원 중심의 AI 활용을 병원 조직 차원의 AI 전환(AX)으로 확대한다.

items.title: AI 신약개발 'K-멜로디' 사업, 종료 후 운영계획 부실 지적
items.excerpt: 총 348억원이 투입되는 연합학습 기반 AI 신약개발 지원사업 'K-멜로디'가 사업 종료 후 운영계획이 부실하다는 국정감사 지적을 받았다.

items.title: AI로 경추척수손상 환자 기관절개술 가능성 조기 예측
items.excerpt: 아주대병원 연구팀이 외상성 경추척수손상 환자의 기관절개술 필요 가능성을 입원 초기에 예측하는 머신러닝 모델을 개발했다.

items.title: AI Can Flag Cognitive Decline Earlier — Health Systems Still Own What Happens Next
items.excerpt: Earlier AI detection of cognitive decline creates a duty that doesn't end when an alert lands in the EHR; health systems must decide in advance how a risk signal becomes a clinical pathway.

items.title: RFK Jr.'s Embrace of AI Confounds Some MAHA Allies and Medical Experts
items.excerpt: At a MAHA summit with AI and Silicon Valley executives, HHS Secretary Kennedy said AI would let Americans "fact check their own medical advice," unsettling some allies and medical experts.

items.title: AI physician agents . . . and other research
items.excerpt: Tom Nolan's weekly BMJ research review leads with studies of AI physician agents, the autonomous LLM systems being tested for clinical tasks.
